lab_hum: a basement laboratory ambience: soft electrical hum, gentle bubbling beakers, an old pipe ticking, loopable, no voices, no music
unroll: a very long paper receipt unrolling fast and spilling onto the floor, rustling paper
beep: a microwave oven button beep, one short electronic beep
step: one soft footstep of a shoe on a concrete basement floor
tick: a timer counting very fast, rapid digital ticking clicks accelerating
wilt: a soft sad cartoon droop sound, a small descending wobble
flop: a flower head falling off and landing softly, a tiny cartoon plop
munch: someone calmly munching popcorn, crunchy, close
rip: a tiny piece of paper torn off a receipt, one quick small rip
ding: a microwave oven ding, one bright bell
chalk: chalk drawing a big circle on a chalkboard, one continuous scrape
whoosh: a quick soft cartoon whoosh swish
